About#

command.Command is a port of the cmdk component by Dip: the same markup, with filtering and keyboard navigation in a JavaScript module.

Installation#

The component's behavior is a JavaScript module served by the runtime. Serve the runtime and load it once per page, as in the components README:

Usage#

Composition#

Use the following composition to build a Command:

Basic#

A simple command menu in a dialog. command.Dialog takes the same children as command.Command.

Scrollable#

Command Palette

Events#

When an item is chosen (Enter or a click), it dispatches a shadcn:select event with detail.value. The root dispatches shadcn:value-change (detail.value) when the selection moves and shadcn:search-change (detail.search) when the search changes. The events bubble.

RTL#

To enable RTL support in shadcn/ui, see the RTL configuration guide.

API Reference#

FunctionOptions
command.Commandcommand.Label(text) (the input's hidden label), command.DefaultValue(value) (default: the first enabled item), command.Loop(bool), command.ShouldFilter(bool) (default true), command.VimBindings(bool) (Ctrl+N/J/P/K, default true), command.DisablePointerSelection(bool)
command.Dialogthe command.Command children, plus command.Title(text) and command.Description(text) (screen-reader only, defaults "Command Palette" and "Search for a command to run..."), command.ShowCloseButton(bool), dialog.DefaultOpen, dialog.Modal(bool); h.Class styles the dialog content
command.InputHTML attributes such as h.Placeholder
command.Listcommand.Label(text) (its aria-label, default "Suggestions")
command.Empty- (shown when no item matches)
command.Groupcommand.Heading(text), command.Value(value) (default: the heading), command.ForceMount(bool)
command.Itemcommand.Value(value) (default: its text content), command.Keywords{...}, command.Disabled(bool), command.ForceMount(bool)
command.Separatorcommand.AlwaysRender(bool) (keep it while searching)
command.Shortcut- (a keyboard hint at the end of an item)

Other children are HTML attributes (h.Class, h.ID, ...) and content. The behavior follows cmdk.
